name: Lady Memoria
source:
Don't let her intimidating countenance and elegant attire destabilize you... Lady Memoria is one twisty bunch of memories! She enjoys being just a little bit on the dark side. Her upfront nature may throw you for a loop - is she really okay with being thrown away? If she's being honest, just know that the one thing she doesn't want is to be forgotten.

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
